description: A complete HTML page implementing a web-based database visualizer interface with embedded CSS and JavaScript for dynamic data loading, interactivity, and UI components.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and injects an HTML table to display data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual cell content, handling objects, long text, and null values.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for detailed view.
